finding: End-2025 state: Hai Long 2A (21 turbines, 300 MW PPA to Taipower) completed and grid-connected by end of 2025; Hai Long 2B (16 turbines) installed but not all generating. Northland's Q4-2025 release (Feb 2026) gives 37 of 73 installed and 20 generating (figure 'currently' as at release, Feb 2026). First power was 12 Jun 2025 (1 of 14 installed turbines). Northland's Q3-2025 release (12 Nov 2025) only says more than half installed and commissioning slower than anticipated. No Northland figure dated exactly 31 Dec 2025; best bracket: 20–21 turbines (~280–294 MW) generating at year end.

sources.quote: The project currently has 37 out of 73 turbines installed, with 20 turbines generating power.
Northland continues to advance the 1.0 GW Hai Long project, installing more than half of the wind turbines and completing installation of export cables.
海龍指出，回顧工程進度，海龍2A風場共21支風機已於去年底如期完工併網；海龍2B風場16支風機亦已於去年安裝完畢，隨著海龍3號風場首支風機安裝，整體計畫已進入關鍵建設階段。
海龍離岸風電計畫今（12）日首次發電典禮，宣布目前已安裝完成的14支風機中，其中一支風機所發出的電力已併入到台電電網內

finding: 12 Aug 2026 (Q2 results): 71 of 73 installed, 59 generating. 15 Oct 2026: all 73 turbines installed and generating power; final permitting approvals expected H1 2027 (commercial operations 2027). Q3-2026 results are NOT yet out: scheduled after market close 12 Nov 2026.

sources.quote: Northland continues to advance construction of the 1.0 GW Hai Long Project in Taiwan, with 71 of 73 turbines installed and 59 generating power.
today announced that all 73 turbines at Hai Long, its 1.0 GW offshore wind project in the Taiwan Strait, are now installed and generating power.
The project remains on track for final permitting approvals in the first half of 2027 as planned, with overall construction costs aligned with original expectations.
announces it will release its 2026 third quarter operating and financial results after markets close on Thursday, November 12, 2026.

finding: No per-turbine 'generating' count published for 31 Dec 2025. Ørsted Annual Report 2025: all turbines and foundations installed (last turbine Jan 2026), ramp-up generation started, remaining array cables ongoing, first power July 2025, full commissioning expected Q3 2026. Q4-2025 earnings call: project 75 % complete (65 % at Q3), remaining array cables to be installed in Q1 2026, 2b export-cable replacement to resume (offshore work in summer 2026). Greater Changhua 4 (42 turbines, 583 MW) was generating in ramp-up; 2b (24 turbines, 337 MW) had no working export cable at end-2025.

sources.quote: Ramp-up generation has started, and the commissioning of turbines is progressing, with full commissioning expected in Q3 2026.
Greater Changhua 2b and 4 Commercial operation date: Q3 2026 All wind turbines and foundations are installed. Installation of remaining array cable work is ongoing. First power reached in July 2025.
Following the previously communicated damage to the export cable for Greater Changhua 2b, we are progressing according to the updated schedule and expect commissioning of the project in Q3 2026.
With the progress achieved during the quarter, the degree of completion is now at 75 % up from 65 % at Q3.
it is the expectation that the remaining array cables will be installed during the first quarter. Also, the project will resume works to replace the export cable for the Greater Changhua 2b section.

finding: H1-2026 interim report (Aug 2026): all Greater Changhua 4 turbines commissioned; 2b export cable to be completed 'in the coming period'; project ~85 % complete. 1 Sep 2026 completion ceremony: full commercial operation expected late Q3 2026. As of 31 Oct 2026 no Ørsted announcement of full commercial operation / Cathay closing was found (orsted.com and orsted.tw news lists are JS-rendered and could not be listed; Ørsted's Q3-2026 report is not yet published). The site's own Taipower samples (data/archive/farm_daily.json, 2026-10-31) still list 沃四風 as '(註10)' with no capacity (trial run) while 沃南風 carries 337.1 MW, i.e. Taipower has not yet counted the 583 MW 沃四風 as installed capacity.
confidence: high for H1 report; COD status unconfirmed

sources.quote: All turbines related to the Greater Changhua 4 have been commissioned, and the installation of export cable for Greater Changhua 2b is planned to be completed in the coming period.

Greater Changhua 2b and 4 comprise 66 Siemens Gamesa 14 MW turbines, all of which were installed by January 2026. In its half-year results in August, Ørsted said all Greater Changhua 4 turbines were commissioned, with the installation of the export cable for Greater Changhua 2b expected to be completed in the coming period.
The Greater Changhua 2b and 4 project is expected to enter full commercial operation in late Q3 2026 upon completion of the remaining commissioning activities

finding: 30 Jul 2026: 1 of 31 installed, 30 to go. 16 Oct 2026: 3 more installed by Taipower/Vestas, cumulative 4 (MOEA statement 18 Oct, reported by LTN which blocks fetches; World Journal/UDN 18 Oct quoted instead: 3 installed on 16 Oct, 27 remaining). None generating; weather window closing, next sailing not scheduled, no spare installation-vessel capacity; Taipower no longer promises end-2026. No newer figure (19–31 Oct) found. Site samples (farm_daily.json) show 離岸二期(註10) with only trace output (e.g. 23 samples summing 15.1 MW on 2026-10-31).

finding: No official per-farm list with grid-connection dates was found.
